assumptions.note: Every number here is an explicit, editable assumption. The UI surfaces all of them in the Methodology panel.

unlisted_uplift.comment: Total wealth / listed-stake value. Accounts for real estate, unlisted operating companies, cash and offshore assets typical of each archetype in Taiwan.

assumptions.range_band_comment: Net worth is shown as a range of mid ± this %, because a point estimate would be false precision.
assumptions.dividend_tax_comment: Taiwan separate taxation on dividend income for high-bracket individuals (28%). Used to derive net cash from the annual dividend run-rate.
assumptions.bankable_share_comment: Share of net dividend cash realistically available for redeployment into managed assets rather than consumed by tax, pledges, reinvestment and family distribution.
assumptions.min_net_worth_comment: Subjects below this estimated net worth are retained in the data but flagged sub-threshold in the UI.

scoring.comment: Prospect score 0-100. Weights must sum to 100.

roster_meta.title: TWSE Principal Shareholder Roster
roster_meta.description: Curated roster of controlling individuals and families behind TWSE-listed issuers. This file is the SLOW-MOVING layer: who holds what, and roughly how much. The fetcher multiplies these stakes against live TWSE prices and share counts to derive wealth estimates. Edit this file to extend coverage; the next scheduled run picks it up.
roster_meta.verification_note: stake_pct_est values are desk estimates aggregated from annual reports, MOPS insider filings and press reporting. They are NOT filings-grade. Verify against MOPS (link on every row) before any client-facing use.
